extra.final_summary:
Average flipper length by species (53 rows after cleaning): Adelie 190.375 mm, Chinstrap 196.0 mm, Gentoo 215.3913 mm.

Problems found and fixes:
- 2 exact duplicate rows (row ids 9 and 22, copies of earlier rows) — removed with drop_duplicates (approved). Left in, they would have double-counted two Adelie penguins and pulled the Adelie average down.
- species and flipper_length_mm were otherwise clean: no missing values, no label variants/misspellings, no numbers stored as text, no negatives, and all values inside the rules-file range of 170–235 mm.

Caveats (not used by this question, so left untouched):
- island has label variants: "Dram" (2) and "Torgerson" (1) vs the allowed "Dream"/"Torgersen".
- sex has a case variant: "FEMALE" (2) vs "female".
- body_mass_g is stored as text with thousands separators (e.g. "3,600"), 2 values written as text.
These do not affect the per-species flipper-length averages but should be fixed before any analysis that groups or filters on island, sex, or body mass.
